From 4f1a02e75a2eedfddd10222c0fe61d2a04d80099 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marco Chiappero <marco.chiappero@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jan 2021 15:35:15 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] crypto: qat - replace CRYPTO_AES with CRYPTO_LIB_AES in
 Kconfig

Use CRYPTO_LIB_AES in place of CRYPTO_AES in the dependences for the QAT
common code.

Fixes: c0e583ab2016 ("crypto: qat - add CRYPTO_AES to Kconfig dependencies")
Reported-by: Ard Biesheuvel <ardb@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Marco Chiappero <marco.chiappero@intel.com>
Acked-by: Ard Biesheuvel <ardb@kernel.org>
Reviewed-by: Giovanni Cabiddu <giovanni.cabiddu@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

diff --git a/drivers/crypto/qat/Kconfig b/drivers/crypto/qat/Kconfig
index 846a3d90b41a..77783feb62b2 100644
--- a/drivers/crypto/qat/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/crypto/qat/Kconfig
@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@ config CRYPTO_DEV_QAT
 	select CRYPTO_SHA1
 	select CRYPTO_SHA256
 	select CRYPTO_SHA512
-	select CRYPTO_AES
+	select CRYPTO_LIB_AES
 	select FW_LOADER
 
 config CRYPTO_DEV_QAT_DH895xCC
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/crypto/qat/Kconfig`**
   - The line `select CRYPTO_AES` was modified to `select CRYPTO_LIB_AES`. This change updates the dependency for the QAT common code to use `CRYPTO_LIB_AES` instead of `CRYPTO_AES`.

### Relationships
- The modification in the `Kconfig` file addresses a dependency issue by replacing `CRYPTO_AES` with `CRYPTO_LIB_AES`. This change is intended to fix a bug that was introduced in a previous commit (c0e583ab2016) that incorrectly added `CRYPTO_AES` as a dependency. The patch is reported to fix this issue and has been reviewed and acknowledged by other developers, indicating a collaborative effort to ensure the correctness of the codebase.
